methods.name: render
methods.doc: Read and convert one Office file using the Session's ordinary filesystem authorization.

methods.name: generation
methods.doc: Read the current rendering generation before reusing a Client PDF.

OfficeToPdfPriority.doc: Foreground previews and explicit QA precede speculative background conversion.

props.name: offset
props.doc: First byte of the window, as requested.

props.name: data
props.doc: Native file bytes; empty at or past EOF.

props.name: eof
props.doc: Whether the window includes the file's last byte.

props.name: absolutePath
props.doc: Absolute path of the file in the filesystem's execution world, symlinks resolved: `/`-separated on POSIX, drive-rooted with the platform separator on Windows. What a `dsh-resource://file/absolute/…` address carries, and what a `dsh-resource://file/session/<sessionId>/…` address's workspace-relative path resolves to against that Session's root.

props.name: version
props.doc: Opaque freshness token at the time of the stat; never parsed.

props.name: bytes
props.doc: Byte size of the complete file, when the backend reports it.

RenderedDocumentBytes.doc: PDF content carries the original Office file's identity and multipart-transferred bytes.
